implementationDetails:
Implemented opt-in turn-end gate hook:

1. crates/jcode-config-types/src/lib.rs — Added HooksConfig.turn_end_gate (Option<String>) + turn_end_gate_timeout_ms (u64, default 5000). Doc comments describe the contract.

2. crates/jcode-base/src/config/env_overrides.rs — Added JCODE_HOOK_TURN_END_GATE and JCODE_HOOK_TURN_END_GATE_TIMEOUT_MS overrides.

3. crates/jcode-base/src/hooks.rs — Added TurnEndGateDecision enum {Continue, Inject{followup_message}}; run_turn_end_gate() (waits with timeout, parses stdout JSON, exit 0 + block JSON => Inject, everything else => Continue); parse_turn_end_followup() with FOLLOWUP_MESSAGE_LIMIT=8000; wired 'turn_end_gate' into hook_command lookup.

4. crates/jcode-app-core/src/agent.rs — Added pending_followup: Option<String> field (init None).

5. crates/jcode-app-core/src/agent/interrupts.rs — Added take_pending_followup() accessor.

6. crates/jcode-app-core/src/agent/turn_execution.rs — fire_turn_end_hook is now async; runs the turn_end observer (unchanged) and then the turn_end_gate when configured and the turn succeeded; queues followup on pending_followup.

7. crates/jcode-app-core/src/server/client_lifecycle.rs — process_message_streaming_mpsc loops while take_pending_followup() returns Some, injecting each followup as the next turn; bounded at MAX_FOLLOWUP_TURNS=1000.

Behavior preserved: no gate configured => pure observer behavior, no waits, herdr-agent-state.sh unaffected. Exit 0 without block JSON, malformed JSON, exit 2, timeout, spawn failure all => Continue (no injection).

Verified: cargo check -p jcode-base -p jcode-config-types -p jcode-app-core passes clean (0 warnings after removing unused mut); cargo test -p jcode-base --lib hooks passes 11/11 including 3 new parse_turn_end_followup tests.
